notifications_screen.purpose: List recent Windows PC notifications in a stacked vertical layout.

layout.header: Top 30px: 'Notifications' title with clear-all button icon on the right.
layout.list_area: Below header (300x190): Up to 3 stacked notification cards (approx 300x55 each).
layout.card_internal: Icon (24x24) on left, App name and Time on top row, Preview text on bottom row.

notifications_screen.motion: New notifications slide in vertically from the top, pushing older ones down.
notifications_screen.interactions: Swipe a specific card left to dismiss it. Tap 'clear all' to wipe the screen.
notifications_screen.rendering_notes: Notifications require string truncation logic on ESP8266 to fit bounds; do not wrap text indefinitely to save rendering cycles. Draw cards as filled rectangles with soft borders.
notifications_screen.prompt: A modern notification center UI on a 320x240 dark screen. It displays stacked glassy cards. The top card shows a Discord icon and message preview, the second from an email client. The layout is spaced perfectly with 'Alert Center' title in the header. The vibe is a clean, distraction-free inbox display.
notifications_screen.motion_prompt: A new notification card smoothly slides down into the stack from the top edge, seamlessly pushing the older cards downwards by exactly the height of one row.
